observations.why: Quinton frames the gate as a security/stability safeguard (conservation) grounded in a craft-quality control practice (competence), appealing to keeping deployments safe and correct.

evidence.quote: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: The summary restates the gate as a mandatory security control — conservation of deployment integrity — without adding new motive language beyond what src-1 already carries.

mints.name: GateAsIntegritySafeguard
mints.title: a gate whose whole reason is preventing unsigned artifacts from shipping
mints.theme: A control is justified not by authority but by the integrity breach it prevents — the gate exists because something slipped through.
